items.reason: A lightweight, fragrance-free ceramide moisturizer to ease the tight, dry feel without feeling heavy on skin that also runs oily.
A gentle, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping, so skin is less likely to feel tight afterward.
A mineral SPF suits sensitive, fair skin and protects the look of your skin through the day.

response.routine_note: Morning: cleanse, moisturize, then apply sunscreen; evening: cleanse and moisturize. If the tightness or sensitivity doesn't ease after a few weeks, a dermatologist can take a closer look.
